Celebrate Victory Day with Megh
2018-12-11T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/celebrate-victory-day-megh-1671733

Fashion house Megh is all set to celebrate the spirit of the upcoming Victory Day. Their festive collection includes panjabis, t-shirts, kameezs, fatuas, frocks and t-shirts for children. The clothes are adorned with various patterns and designs with red and green serving as the base.

You can shop at various Megh outlets at Dhaka's Aziz Super Market, Metro Shopping Mall and various other places.

For more information, please call 01611 634423 or visit www.facebook.com/meghfashionbd
